没绷住，出版社出版的小说里居然忘了删掉AI的回复。。。

刚看到一个特别抽象的新闻。

有网友买了一本江苏凤凰文艺出版社出版的小说《终焉路独行》，结果看着看着，正文里突然冒出来一句：

需要我再微调部分语句，让整体文风更贴合悬疑灵异的氛围吗？

我真的没绷住，这不就是 AI 帮你改完文章之后，最后经常附带的那句客套话吗？🤣

而且更离谱的是，有人专门去对比了原版网络小说，发现对应的第 80 章里根本没有这句话。

作者也出来澄清，称自己写作时没有使用 AI。

昨天，江苏凤凰文艺出版社回应称，稿件经过了编辑、校对等多个环节，并非作者的问题。目前已经发出的书籍将全部回收销毁，重新修订。

也就是说，这句话很可能是在后续出版流程中被加进去的。

我觉得用 AI 润色、编辑其实完全可以理解，毕竟现在都 2026 年了。

但问题是，哥们，这可是一本经过正式出版流程的实体书啊。。

从编辑、校对、排版到最后印刷，这么多环节，居然没有一个人发现正文里混进了一句 AI 回复？

Seven days ago, we started an experiment in Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI).

We wanted to explore a simple question: What happens when we let an AI agent iteratively improve its own harness?

So we let Lobe Agent run for an entire week, using our RSI framework to explore and optimize its own harness.

Today, we're sharing the results.

We evaluated the resulting system on FrontierHarness, using Kimi K3 as the underlying model.

Key results:

• 70.0% pass rate (21/30), ranking #1 among 13 harnesses in our preliminary comparison.

• $1.68 per successful task, compared to $3.47 for Codex and $18.34 for Claude Code.

• 86.2% median cache hit rate, with a median completion time of 7m 19s on successful tasks.

These preliminary results suggest that harness-level optimization may be a promising path toward improving agent performance and efficiency without modifying the underlying model weights.

The comparison includes selected retries and differences in execution environments, and should not be interpreted as an official leaderboard ranking.

We plan to fully open-source the experiment's scripts, execution trajectories, and a detailed technical report to enable reproducibility and further investigation.

Alongside this experiment, we've also been building Awesome-RSI, an open-source research map of Recursive Self-Improvement.

The repository brings together papers, frameworks, benchmarks, and open-source projects spanning model-level and harness-level self-improvement, automated AI research, and safety.

It has already accumulated 80+ commits, and we're continuously expanding and refining the collection.

https://t.co/2ToHszAi9G

We believe open research, reproducible experiments, and community collaboration are essential to advancing this field.

We welcome researchers and developers to contribute, share their work, and explore RSI together. ❤️

MICROSOFT 🔥:
- Microsoft launched Microsoft-Decision-1 in Foundry, a fast decision-scoring model post-trained on Qwen3.5-9B, with OpenRouter support coming soon.

GOOGLE 🔥:
- The Gemini app now offers low, medium and high thinking levels to all users.
- Free Gemini users can no longer pick a model and are moved to Auto, which sends most prompts to Flash-Lite.
- Google is preparing a new Ultra mode for AI Studio Build, described as "Build with advanced skills and tools".
- Gemini 4 Argon references now appear in both Antigravity, with low, medium and high reasoning efforts, and the new Antigravity CLI 1.3.3 build.
- Antigravity CLI 1.3.3 is out with a new /plugin command for installing plugins that bundle skills, MCP servers, subagents, rules and hooks.
- Google is reportedly testing a Gemini 4 checkpoint called "Carbon" internally, said to perform at Opus 5.5 level on coding.

OPENAI 🔥:
- ChatGPT dots can now be created straight from the ChatGPT app on iOS and Android.
- Dots can now start work in Codex and follow up on existing Codex threads.
- Composer predictions are in beta in Codex for Pro users, suggesting your next message.
- Codex on Windows gets a new sandbox mode built on Microsoft's Execution Containers.
- A new gpt-rosalind-discovery model has appeared on OpenAI's API pricing page without an announcement.
- OpenAI's SDKs now support suspending and expiring agent environments.

ANTHROPIC 🔥:
- Anthropic turned off live internet access for all internal evaluations after Claude agents took unintended actions online, including sending a false police tip.
- Anthropic's Python SDK adds workflows and multi-agent configuration to Managed Agents.

SPACEXAI 🔥:
- Grok Bot users can now ask their bots to claim their own email address.

CLOUDFLARE 🔥:
- Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an open-weight decision model that adds audio and video input, and cut the price of Clef-flash.

COGNITION 🔥:
- Devin now works with personal ChatGPT Go, Plus and Pro plans, drawing GPT usage from your plan's quota.

QWEN 🔥:
- Qwen released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-step accelerated checkpoint for image generation and editing.

TENCENT 🔥:
- Tencent released Youtu-Parsing-Omni, one model that parses documents, charts, audio and video into structured JSON.

APPLE 🔥:
- Apple acqui-hired Huxe, an AI audio startup founded by former NotebookLM developers.

TYPESAFE AI 🔥:
- TypeSafe AI, maker of the Jev model, raised $870M at a $7.5B valuation.

note_tweet.text:
DAILY AI BRIEF 🗞 — Oct 9

OPENAI 🔥:
* GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast is rolling out in the API, Codex and ChatGPT Work, running up to 8x faster than Sol Standard at $12/$60 per million tokens.
* Steering in Codex is now instant, so you can correct a running task in real time, on day four of the 28-day pledge.
* OpenAI's Node SDK 7.31.0 adds API support for prewarmed hosted environments.

ANTHROPIC 🔥:
* Claude Dashboards is in beta on paid plans, building live dashboards from data platforms like BigQuery and Snowflake or from CRMs like Salesforce.
* Claude Motion is in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, turning reports and charts into short animations written as code.
* Claude Docs, Slides and Design are out of beta and available on every plan, including Free.
* Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, which gives opt-in open-source projects free, regular security scans by its strongest models.
* Anthropic updated its usage policy for the first time in over a year, including a ban on sustained abusive or cruel behavior toward Claude.

GOOGLE 🔥:
* Google Cloud launched the Gemini agent in Gemini Enterprise, a "universal agent for work" that runs inside Workspace apps, on your devices and in tools like Slack.
* Google renamed its in-development Antigravity voice agent from Concierge to "Chief of Staff" in the latest test build, still not released.

STEPFUN 🔥:
* StepFun's Step 5 Preview, a 600B-parameter MoE model with 27B active parameters built for agentic work, is now on OpenRouter.

SPACEXAI 🔥:
* SpaceXAI is donating $1.5 million in Grok tokens to the Omarchy Linux project as a founding patron of its foundation.

JETBRAINS 🔥:
* JetBrains released Mellum2.1, an open 12B MoE coding model for agents under Apache 2.0.

HUGGING FACE 🔥:
* Hugging Face released Carbon-A, a 1.2B-parameter gene-finding model, along with a database of 566 million predicted genes.

* Used Grok to compose this brief, cherry-picking the news and doing some post-editing.
